description: The About window (open_about_window in lib.rs, macOS only) loads the app bundle with ?about-window=1 and shows one panel, which closes itself and opens links in the browser (AboutWindow.tsx). Those are its only grants, so a script in that window reaches nothing on disk: the Markdown folder's file grants stay on the main window, and it holds none of the app's own commands, which build.rs declares in an app manifest so that each window gets only the ones a capability grants it (beta issue 167; the main window's set is app-commands.json).
